create_waterparked.ponder.tag.slide_atta: Attachments which mount onto a waterslide and change how riders pass through it
Put a shaft into the door hub and it will drive the door
How far the shaft turns decides how far the door opens
create_waterparked.ponder.detector_ponde: The band hugs the inner wall and ends where a sector is open
A rider crossing it switches the hub on and it emits redstone
Put a display link on the hub to read how many riders have passed
create_waterparked.ponder.accelerator_po: The band boosts whoever crosses it, along the direction of the arrows
A shaft drives it: the faster it turns, the stronger the boost
Wrench the direction handle to aim the boost, or hold Alt to ignore the grid
create_waterparked.ponder.sa_ponder_0.te: Right-click the slide with a slide attachment to pick a spot
Then place the block on the ground
The attachment appears on the slide at the bound spot
create_waterparked.ponder.ponder_connect: Right-click two waterslide anchors with a waterslide track to connect them
A waterslide spline is created between the two anchors
A wrench can be used to adjust the path of the spline
create_waterparked.ponder.slide_ponder_0: Right-click two waterslide anchors with a waterslide track......
Some controls of the waterslide work exactly like coaster track.
A wrench can be used to adjust the path of the slide
Drag left and right to adjust the tube opening size
create_waterparked.ponder.slide_ponder_1: Right-click two waterslide anchors with a block......
A sector with the corresponding block texture can be added.
Right-click two waterslide anchors with an axe......
An empty sector can be added.
You can use a wrench to adjust the position and size of sectors
create_waterparked.ponder.slide_ponder_2: Hold a wrench in your main hand and a block in your offhand......
A ghost block is placed, hugging the outside of the tube wall.
Ghost blocks follow the curve of the slide.
Right-clicking with an axe removes ghost blocks......

create_waterparked.roller.hinge_wrong_ax: The block on that face turns the wrong way to hinge this run
create_waterparked.attachment.selected: Position selected - place the binding block near the slide
create_waterparked.ponder.grab_bar_ponde: Mounted on a slide mouth, the bar spans the opening and blocks automatic entry
Walk up to the bar and it takes hold: hold forward to charge the launch
While someone holds it the hub emits redstone
A display link on the hub counts every grab
create_waterparked.ponder.roller_ponder_: Roller conveyors carry loads along a run of rollers
Funnels and chests feed the run on their own
Loads ride the rollers and leave the run at its end
Mount a hinge shaft on the end of a run, insert a shaft, and the run can rotate
A wrench on the shaft flips its latch
Unlatched, a tilted arm lets its loads slide on their own
item.create_waterparked.brass_plier.tool: A precision tool for _tuning slide control points_
drag handles along axes, planes or fixed-length arcs with neighbour snapping
hold Ctrl to open the settings rings
create_waterparked.pliers.activated: Pliers edit session bound to this anchor
